rachats.citation: In May 2016, ASR Nederland N.V. acquired 100% of the shares of BNG Vermogensbeheer B.V. (BNG).
In September 2016, ASR Deelnemingen N.V. acquired 100% of the shares of Certitudo Investments B.V. and its subsidiaries SuperGarant Verzekeringen and SuperGarant Zorg.
In October 2016 ASR Deelnemingen N.V. acquired 100% of the shares of Corins B.V.
In December 2017, ASR Vermogensbeheer N.V. acquired 100% of the shares of First Investments B.V.

On 6 February 2018, ASR Nederland N.V. announced the completion of its acquisition of Generali Nederland N.V. ... by acquiring all issued and outstanding shares for a total consideration of € 153 million paid in cash.
On 1 May 2019, a.s.r. announced the completion of its acquisition of Loyalis N.V. (Loyalis) by acquiring all issued and outstanding shares for a total consideration of € 436 million paid in cash
In September 2019, Certitudo Investments B.V. acquired 100% of the shares of Argon Groep B.V. and Van Kampen Groep Holding B.V. acquired 100% of the shares of Melching Groep B.V.

On 1 January 2020, a.s.r. and ASR Schadeverzekering N.V. (a.s.r. non-life) completed the acquisitions of VvAA Levensverzekeringen N.V. (VvAA life) and Veherex Schade N.V. (Veherex) respectively by acquiring all issued and outstanding shares for a total consideration of € 57 million.
On 1 January 2020, ASR Schadeverzekering N.V. (a.s.r. non-life) acquired 100% shares of Veherex Schade N.V. (Veherex).
On 1 April 2021, a.s.r. completed the acquisition of Brand New Day IORP by acquiring the remaining 50% of outstanding shares for a total consideration of € 70 million.
In May 2022, the acquisition of Sweco Capital Consultants was completed.

On 4 July 2023, a.s.r. announced the completion of the business combination between a.s.r. and Aegon Ltd. (formerly known as Aegon N.V.) by acquiring the shares of Aegon NL. / ...by acquiring the shares of Aegon Nederland N.V. for a total consideration of € 4.9 billion.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
